primary.entity: white notice paper on the poster wall
primary.what: An unprompted white notice sheet (small photo at its top) hangs on the poster wall left of and below the switch plates in Shot2 f0-f1 and Shot6 f5 at the same offset from the switches, but in Shot1 f1-f5 that spot is bare wall although it is in view.

primary.entity: rear-wall shelves, two white banners and red emblem
primary.what: Behind the two men in Shot5 the rear of the room shows wall shelves with items, two white vertical banners with a red emblem between them and posters, while Shot4, looking the same way over the Older man's back, shows a plain rear wall with only a ladder and flag and none of these items.

secondary.entity: Older man's shirt pocket contents (carried items)
secondary.what: The left-chest pocket is visible and empty in Shot2 f4-f5 but holds a pale rectangular card and pens in Shot6 and Shot8.

secondary.entity: extra fist at the Older man's shoulder (body part)
secondary.what: From f1 on a third bare fist appears on the Older man's shoulder beside the Sleeveless man's two raised fists; it is absent in f0 and its owner is unclear.
Same viewing direction, different room: Shot4 has a plain rear wall and a large tan mat on the blue floor, Shot5 has mirror panels on the left wall and an all-blue floor with no tan mat.
The belt is clearly navy blue in Shot1 f0 but black in Shot4.

unspecified_seen: Second square switch box and vertical wall cable (Shot1, Shot3, Shot6, Shot8, consistent); white notice paper on the poster wall (Shot2, Shot6, missing in Shot1); second red poster at top-left of the poster wall (Shot2, Shot3, Shot6, Shot8, consistent); fire alarm and wall sensor in the corridor through the doorway (Shot1 only); orange wedge mat and ceiling lights (Shot4 only); wall shelves, white banners, red emblem, posters, whiteboard, wall bars (Shot5 only); white wall panel behind the Sleeveless man (Shot7 only).
